summary: Starwood Real Estate Income Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose an ordinary amendment to its share repurchase plan (SRP) and a reduction in its monthly distribution rate. The filing does not announce a tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, activist campaign, or other transformative special situation. The SRP change is a routine adjustment to repurchase terms (death/disability and small-account full repurchases, limited by monthly caps), and the distribution reduction is a standard business decision tied to market conditions. Neither event constitutes a special-situation corporate action requiring categorization under the defined categories. The SEC filing source is a current report, not a definitive agreement or proxy for a fundamental change.
